body:
Adds saved gameplay measurements and per-player AI readouts, plus efficient session performance measurements, through the existing team timeline exports. Distributed tournaments retain the complete records in verified logs and expose typed, streaming JSONL/CSV through their existing offline analysis commands.

Gameplay statistics have a second text-panel page and additional post-match graph pages. AI/performance diagnostics have no new UI. Simulation orders, RNG, checksums, AI decisions and default HUD behavior are unchanged. Save formats advance to 105/106 above master's 104, preserving the minimum supported format (58), replay floor (99), and network/YOG gates (33).

One-off validation reports, benchmark dumps and the evidence archive are removed from the final repository tree. Permanent documentation covers metric definitions, extending collection, save coverage, output records and tournament usage. Regression tests remain, with the performance harness and new offline readers added to CI.

## Verification

- Fresh optimized macOS arm64 build and team-statistics/performance/reader tests pass. Strict translation validation, font/layout checks and all 203 standalone tests pass. All statistics labels are localized.
- Initial CI identified blank translations and a stale C++17 standalone test configuration. Both are fixed; standalone gradient tests now link the performance collector. The Windows performance harness also uses the same console entry-point setup as the save/statistics harnesses. No simulation code changed in these fixes.
- Fresh comparison against unmodified master `1537cb280`: all eight AIs, identical generator/seed/input saves, **14,332 per-tick component records match**, and final team outcomes match. Covers initial saves and master-format-104 continuations from tick 513 through 2048.
- Cross-platform execution: 2,048 per-tick component records match between Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 CI and macOS arm64, both consuming the exact Linux-generated initial save. [CI input and trace artifacts](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/actions/runs/34907000364) (`tournament-cli-ubuntu-24.04`, `configured/initial.game`).
- Retained real worker/coordinator test: 17 successful jobs covering all eight AIs, exact export-on/off execution, repeated save/load measurements, complete final records, and offline counts matching transferred logs.
- Save-safety, genuine format-84/88 expectations, replay acceptance boundaries and 14 structured CLI cases passed before the documentation-only cleanup.

Evidence remains accessible in PR commit history rather than the merged tree:
- [Commands, coverage and limitations](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/85f39248d/docs/tournament-telemetry-validation.md)
- [Retained saves, traces, logs, job records and offline artifacts](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/raw/85f39248d/test/fixtures/tournaments/game-telemetry-20260914.tar.gz) and [SHA-256 index](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/85f39248d/test/fixtures/tournaments/game-telemetry-20260914.index.json)
- [Earlier performance measurements and limits](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/85f39248d/docs/performance-telemetry-validation.md)

No gameplay pacing/balance change is intended or observed in these execution comparisons. Timing measurements were noisy and previously accepted; no sub-1% overhead claim is made. Runtime behavior comparisons cover macOS arm64 and Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 for the shared initial-state case above; Windows behavior equivalence is not claimed. Interactive playtesting and full distributed tournament telemetry on remote Linux/Windows workers are not claimed.
title: Expand gameplay, AI and performance telemetry with tournament exports
